symptoms: Alvarado Score criteria: Migratory RIF pain (1), Anorexia (1), Nausea/Vomiting (1), RIF tenderness (2), Rebound tenderness (1), Fever (1), Leucocytosis (2), Neutrophilic left shift (1). Total 10.

Paediatric Appendicitis Score (PAS): Cough/Percussion/Hopping tenderness (2), RLQ tenderness (2), Anorexia (1), Fever (1), Nausea/Vomiting (1), WBC > 10 (1), Neutrophilia (1), Migration to RLQ (1). Total 10.

management_steps.details: Hypovolaemia: 20 ml/kg Balsol/Ringers Lactate. Septic shock: 20 ml/kg Balsol/Ringers Lactate + Augmentin 30mg/kg IV.
Analgesia: Morphine 0.1mg/kg IV. Antiemetic: Maxolon 0.1mg/kg (not in children < 1 years old).

Bedside: U-dipstix on all patients, U-BHCG on all female patients. Laboratory: FBC/CRP/U&E. Radiological: Graded compression ultrasound/CT; CXR erect if perforation is suspected. Urgent Surgical consultation.

warnings: Maxolon is contraindicated in children < 1 years old.
Patients in the low risk group do not have a zero risk. Treat according to clinical judgment.
